notes.title: Volume² 1.1.8.465
notes.content:
Implemented support Voicemeeter devices
Added change tray/OSD skin for Dark mode

notes.title: Volume² 1.1.8.461
notes.content: Fixed issue related to context menu in Volume2PM

notes.title: Volume² 1.1.8.460
notes.content:
Added support for OSC protocol ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/241]#241[/url])
New hotkey action - Mute all microphones ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/225]#225[/url])
Added the ability to control the default recording device ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/207]#207[/url])
Fixed application volume control when it is not on default audio device
Custom sound settings was added ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/210]#210[/url])
Fixed update tray icon after a new device was connected

notes.title: Version 1.1.8.458
notes.content:
Fixed an issue related to play sound after changing the volume ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/94]#94[/url])
Added per-device volume control method ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/174]#174[/url])
Added possibility to disable OSD for scheduler ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/189]#189[/url])
Added autoresize of Windows mixer ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/182]#182[/url])
Improved Dark mode ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/170]#170[/url])

notes.title: Version 1.1.8.456
notes.content:
Fixed behavior of hotkeys (Win + RMB) when controlling an alternative device ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/183]#183[/url])
Fixed volume control over the second, third taskbar ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/181]#181[/url])
Fixed autodetection System language ([url=https://github.com/irzyxa/Volume2/issues/176]#176[/url])
Added automatic font color detection depending on background color
Fixed font color for checkboxes/radiobuttons

notes.title: Version 1.1.8.453
notes.content:
Fixed program crash for some languages because incorrect translation
Fixed issue related to device connection (#168)
Fixed issues related to alternative tray icon
Added Show Inactive Devices option to Audio Device Manager
Added set default device on single mouse click in Audio Device Manager (available in User Variables - ADMApplyImmediately)

notes.title: Version 1.1.7.449
notes.content:
Added function Turn On monitor
Fixed high CPU usage when offline (#162)
Moved Interface Settings and User Variables to main Settings screen
Added possibility to rename devices using Audio Device Manager 
Improved dark mode (Windows 10, 11)
Fixed view of the context menu in the tray for Windows 11
Added tray icon for alternative device
